record.paper_title: Geometric and Topological Obstructions to Various Immersions in Submanifold Theory and Some Related Open Problems
record.original_question: What additional obstructions prevent a Riemannian manifold M from admitting a CR-immersion into a Kahler manifold, beyond the necessary conditions that M admit a CR structure, that the orthogonal complement of Re(H plus conjugate H) in TM be integrable, and that Re(H plus conjugate H) be a minimal distribution? A CR-submanifold has a holomorphic distribution D and a totally real distribution D^perp with TM = D direct-sum D^perp.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\tilde M, J, \tilde g)$ be a Kähler manifold, with complex structure $J$ and compatible Riemannian metric $\tilde g$. A Riemannian submanifold $M \subset \tilde M$ is called a CR-submanifold if there exist two orthogonal smooth distributions $\mathcal D$ and $\mathcal D^\perp$ on $M$ with $TM = \mathcal D \oplus \mathcal D^\perp$ such that $\mathcal D$ is holomorphic (i.e. $J\mathcal D_p = \mathcal D_p$ for every $p \in M$) and $\mathcal D^\perp$ is totally real (i.e. $J\mathcal D^\perp_p \subset T_p^\perp M$ for every $p \in M$). An isometric immersion of a Riemannian manifold $M$ into a Kähler manifold realizing $M$ as a CR-submanifold is called a CR-immersion.

Recall that an (abstract) CR structure on a smooth manifold $M$ is a complex subbundle $H \subset T_{\mathbb C}M = TM \otimes \mathbb C$ such that $H \cap \overline H = 0$ and $H$ is involutive (i.e. $[H,H] \subset H$). Set $\mathrm{Re}(H \oplus \overline H) := \{X + \overline X : X \in H\} \subset TM$, a real distribution on $M$.

Three known necessary conditions for a Riemannian manifold $M$ to admit a CR-immersion into some Kähler manifold are:
(i) $M$ carries a CR structure $H$;
(ii) the orthogonal complementary distribution $(\mathrm{Re}(H \oplus \overline H))^\perp$ in $TM$ is integrable;
(iii) the distribution $\mathrm{Re}(H \oplus \overline H)$ is a minimal distribution (its leaves, where defined, are minimal).

Problem: Determine whether there exist additional obstructions, beyond conditions (i)–(iii), that prevent a Riemannian manifold $M$ from admitting a CR-immersion into a Kähler manifold; and if so, exhibit and characterize such obstructions.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in the survey on geometric and topological obstructions to immersions. A search for subsequent literature on additional obstructions to CR-immersions of Riemannian manifolds into Kähler manifolds did not return results announcing a resolution; related surveys on Riemannian submanifolds and B.-Y. Chen's program list only the three classical obstructions. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Riemannian Submanifolds: A Survey
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses CR-submanifolds in Kähler manifolds and lists obstructions to CR-immersions including integrability of the orthogonal complement and minimality.
status_evidence.claim: Standard surveys list the three classical necessary conditions but do not announce additional obstructions.
